body.name: Pn
body.def: \(\mathsf P_n^{h,\rho}\) is the sampling law for the fixed array \(B_n\): draw the independent simple-random holdouts, then the two independent stratumwise stage-1 complete randomizations, observe responses from \(Y^{(h)}\), realize \(C_n(\rho)\), and finally draw independent stage-2 complete randomizations only in recruited strata conditional on \(\mathcal F_{n,1}(\rho)\).
body.role: chronological local-alternative sampling law at holdout fraction \(\rho\)
